format: one deterministic JSON object per retained non-EOS work item; per-output JSONL compressed with gzip after cell completion

prefix_hash.purpose: target-blind prefix provenance during generation and exact transformed-Gold prefix labeling after the pre-Gold freeze

invariants: each retained non-EOS work item has one insertion record
work_item_id is unique within a cell
non-root parent_work_item_id references an inserted work item
child prefix hash equals the canonical hash of parent prefix plus selected token
local_token_rank is rank in the full legal pre-retention ARC-token distribution
an expanded work item has exactly one pop record
a never-expanded work item has null pop fields and a legal pending final status
telemetry never changes retention, scheduler policy order, model forwards, cache behavior, or search accounting
reconstruction_boundary: A record is pending immediately before expansion t when inserted_at_expanded_nodes <= t and (popped_at_expanded_nodes is null or popped_at_expanded_nodes > t). The implementation records a pop just before its matching scientific expansion.
